name: tanstack-field
title: TanStackField
description: Source-owned Solid field adapter connecting TanStack Form field state to Keystone form-control semantics.

meta.customization: Style the generated field shell, label, description, and error parts through ui-tanstack-field classes, Keystone Core data attributes, TanStack meta data attributes, and neutral data-slot hooks.
meta.api: TanStackField exports TanStackField plus TanStackFieldApi, TanStackFormApi, TanStackFieldRenderContext, and TanStackFieldProps types. It renders form.Field, derives first error and invalid state from TanStack field meta, creates a Keystone form-control contract, and passes control, field, value, invalid, firstError, focused, and setFocused to child renderers.
meta.accessibility: Backed by @keystone-ui/core/form for generated IDs, label/control relationships, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, required/disabled/readonly metadata, error alert wiring, and stable field state data attributes. TanStack Form remains responsible for value, touched, dirty, validating, blur, and validation lifecycle state.
meta.limitations: TanStackField is a render-prop adapter instead of a hidden context runtime. Concrete controls still decide how to call handleChange and handleBlur so text, select, combobox, checkbox, and file controls can preserve their own primitive behavior.

parity.tanstackForm: First-class TanStack Form parity: form.Field integration, validator pass-through, field value and meta access, touched-derived invalid state, dirty/validating metadata, blur/change delegation, and source-owned render-prop composition.
parity.baseUi: Field semantics are inherited through Keystone Core FormControl: generated IDs, label/description/error relationships, invalid/required/disabled/read-only attributes, and stable data attributes.
parity.kobalte: Solid form-control parity follows Keystone Core Field/FormControl while preserving TanStack Form as the app-state owner.
